title: StudioEpisodeState
description: Canonical Studio Episode lifecycle state. Frozen at studio.contract/v0.1. Normal progression is DRAFT -> IDEA_REVIEW -> STORY_BIBLE_REVIEW -> OUTLINE_REVIEW -> SCREENPLAY_REVIEW -> (REVISING -> SCREENPLAY_REVIEW)* -> LOCKED -> READY_FOR_PRODUCTION. FAILED and CANCELLED are explicit terminal outcomes.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency version of the Episode aggregate. Mutations require an expected version.
